title: AI combine rule (proposed, AAR-567)
description: Shape and allowed values of the rule stored in ai-model.rule on the feature-flags Basic, and of the default rule shipped with each model. Checks this schema cannot express are done by the app: member and class ids must exist in the model, a photo votesNeeded number must not exceed the members running, modelId must equal ai-model.id. Fields marked Later are designed but rejected by the first release.

schema.description: Rule format version. A number the app does not know is rejected.

id.description: The rule's name, saved with every result, e.g. oral-3class-v1/majority.

members.description: Member models to run. Default: all members the model ships. May drop members, cannot add one.

lowConfidence.description: Later. What happens to a photo whose confidence % is below the cut.

case.description: Photos -> the case result. Default: the most serious photo decides (vote, votesNeeded any, countMoreSevere true).

votes.description: all = every vote (AND); majority = more than half; any = at least one (OR); a number = at least that many.

votesNeeded.description: One value for every class, or a map of class id -> value. A class left out of the map can only be the fallback.

fallback.description: Result when no class gets enough votes: a class id, or inconclusive (needs the Inconclusive screen). Default: the least serious class.

weights.description: Later, mean only. Default 1 for every member.

thresholds.description: Later, mean + decideBy thresholds only. Checked from most serious to least.

onFailedPhoto.description: What a photo where AI failed does to the case. inconclusive needs the Inconclusive screen.

minPhotos.description: Later. Fewer photos with an AI result -> Inconclusive.
